58300.meaning1: who is satisfied; who is pleased; who is content

examples.text: santussako ca subharo ca, appakicco ca sallahukavutti, sant'indriyo ca nipako ca, appagabbho kulesu ananugiddho.

atthi kho, bhikkhu, yāmā nāma devā… suyāmo nāma devaputto… tusitā nāma devā… santussito nāma devaputto… nimmānaratī nāma devā… sunimmito nāma devaputto… paranimmitavasavattī nāma devā… vasavattī nāma devaputto amhehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.

58306.grammar: prp, masc & nt loc sg of santa, loc abs, intrans

kodho mosavajjañ'ca kathaṃkathā ca, ete'pi dhammā dvayam'eva sante, kathaṃkathī ñāṇapathāya sikkhe, ñatvā pavuttā samaṇena dhammā.

58307.meaning1: here there are; in this case they are

examples.text: sant'ettha, bhikkhave, upāsikāyo sot'āpannā, santi sakadāgāminiyo, santi anāgāminiyo. sabbā tā, bhikkhave, upāsikāyo anipphalā kālaṅ'katā'ti.
mā, samaṇa, etaṃ dāyaṃ pāvisi. sant'ettha tayo kulaputtā attakāmarūpā viharanti. mā tesaṃ aphāsum'akāsī'ti

hoti saddo ratho iti,

hoti satto'ti sammuti

58310.meaning2: with resident pupils; i.e. with internal impurities

58311.meaning1: virtuous men; good people; wise people; sages; the good

examples.text: jīranti ve rājarathā sucittā, atho sarīram'pi jaraṃ upeti, satañ'ca dhammo na jaraṃ upeti, santo have sabbhi pavedayanti.
tasmā satañ'ca asataṃ nānā hoti ito gati, asanto nirayaṃ yanti, santo saggaparāyanā'ti.

58313.commentary: (DNa) idha, mahārāja, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hotī'ti ettha santuṭṭho'ti itar'ītarapaccayasantosena samannāgato. so pan'esa santoso dvādasavidho hoti, seyyath'idaṃ, cīvare yathālābhasantoso, yathābalasantoso, yathāsāruppasantoso'ti tividho. evaṃ piṇḍapāt'ādīsu. tass'āyaṃ pabhedavaṇṇanā

examples.text: satisampajaññena samannāgato'ti abhikkante paṭikkante'ti-ādīsu sattasu ṭhānesu satiyā c'eva sampajaññena ca samannāgato hoti. santuṭṭho'ti catūsu paccayesu tividhena santosena santuṭṭho hoti.

58315.meaning1: discussion on contentment; talk about satisfaction

examples.text: [imassa anantaraṃ so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedetī'ti vacanaṃ dīghanikāye āgataṃ, taṃ idha santosakathā-avasāne āgataṃ, sā ca santosakathā tattha satisampajaññ'ānantaram'eva āgatā]

kathaṃ? etesu hi appicchakathā santosakathā asaṃsaggakathā sīlakathā'ti imā catasso kathā adhisīlasikkhāsaṅgahitā'y'eva. pavivekakathā vīriy'ārambhakathā samādhikathā'ti imā tisso adhicittasikkhasaṅgahitā.

58316.commentary: (VIN 1.4.11) santhataṃ nāma santharitvā kataṃ hoti avāyimaṃ. (VINa) santharitvā kataṃ hotī'ti same bhūmibhāge kosiyaṃsūni upar'ūpari santharitvā kañjik'ādīhi siñcitvā kataṃ hoti

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu kosiyamissakaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

58317.commentary: (VIN 1.4.11) santhataṃ nāma santharitvā kataṃ hoti avāyimaṃ. (VINa) santharitvā kataṃ hotī'ti same bhūmibhāge kosiyaṃsūni upar'ūpari santharitvā kañjik'ādīhi siñcitvā kataṃ hoti

examples.text: nisīdanasanthataṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāya.
anādā ce bhikkhu purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthiṃ, navaṃ nisīdanasanthataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

58318.synonym: atthata, ācita, upalitta, channaka, vitata, santharita

examples.text: paṃsukūladharaṃ jantuṃ, kisaṃ dhamanisanthataṃ, ekaṃ vanasmiṃ jhāyantaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
najjāyo supatitthāyo, soṇṇavālukasanthatā, acchā savanti ambūni, macchagumbanisevitā.

58320.commentary: (VINa) dinnā saṅghena itthan'nāmassa bhikkhuno santhatasammutī'ti evaṃ laddhasammutiko bhikkhu yāva rogo na vūpasammati, tāva yaṃ yaṃ ṭhānaṃ gacchati, tattha tattha santhataṃ kātuṃ labhati.

58322.meaning1: stands firm; remains steadfast; is resolute; takes heart

examples.text: moneyyaṃ te upaññissaṃ, dukkaraṃ durabhisambhavaṃ, handa te naṃ pavakkhāmi, santhambhassu daḷho bhava.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu raj'aggaññ'eva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ. sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati.

58326.meaning1: to remain firm; to stay strong; to keep one's peace; to restrain oneself

examples.text: jant'āgharaṃ cikkhallaṃ hoti … anujānāmi, bhikkhave, santharituṃ tayo santhare, iṭṭhakāsantharaṃ, silāsantharaṃ, dārusantharan'ti. cikkhallaṃ'y'eva hoti … anujānāmi, bhikkhave, dhovitun'ti.
seyyaṃ kappeyyā'ti mañcassa vā pīṭhassa vā pavisantassa vā nikkhamantassa vā upacāre seyyaṃ santharati vā santharāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa. abhinisīdati vā abhinipajjati vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.

58333.meaning1: causes to put out; makes place out

examples.text: santharāpetvā'ti aññaṃ santharāpetvā. anupasampannaṃ santharāpeti, tassa palibodho. upasampannaṃ santharāpeti, santhārakassa palibodho.
seyyaṃ kappeyyā'ti mañcassa vā pīṭhassa vā pavisantassa vā nikkhamantassa vā upacāre seyyaṃ santharati vā santharāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa. abhinisīdati vā abhinipajjati vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.

58334.meaning1: having caused to put out; having made place out

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghikaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā bhisiṃ vā kocchaṃ vā ajjhokāse santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā taṃ pakkamanto n'eva uddhareyya, na uddharāpeyya, anāpucchaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.
āmantayi cundakaṃ nāma bhikkhuṃ, catugguṇaṃ santhara me nipajjaṃ, so codito bhāvit'attena cundo, catugguṇaṃ santhari khippam'eva.

58337.synonym: atthata, ācita, upalitta, channaka, vitata, santhata

examples.text: upasaṅkamitvā sabbasantharitaṃ satthataṃ āvasath'āgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññapetvā udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā telapadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu

58338.meaning1: should be spread; should be covered

examples.text: sāmantā sugatavidatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāyā'ti thirabhāvāya vaṭṭaṃ vā caturassaṃ vā chinditvā ekadese vā santharitabbaṃ vijaṭetvā vā santharitabbaṃ.

58340.meaning1: having put out; having placed out; having laid out
58340.meaning2: having spread, having strewed, having covered with

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghikaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā bhisiṃ vā kocchaṃ vā ajjhokāse santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā taṃ pakkamanto n'eva uddhareyya, na uddharāpeyya, anāpucchaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.

58341.commentary: (SNa) santhavan'ti mittasanthavaṃ. taṇhāsanthavo pana na kenaci saddhiṃ kātabbo, mittasanthavo buddha-paccekabuddha-buddhasāvakehi saha kātabbo. idaṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, sattā gacchanti suggatin'ti.
okaṃ pahāya aniketasārī, gāme akubbaṃ muni santhavāni, kāmehi ritto apurekkharāno, kathaṃ na viggayha janena kayirā.
kodho mado thambho paccupaṭṭhāpanā, māyā usūyā bhassasamussayo ca, mān'ātimāno ca asabbhi santhavo, es'āmagandho na hi maṃsabhojanaṃ.

58344.meaning1: very familiar; intimately connected; closely acquainted (with)

examples.text: kathañ'ca, gahapati, gāme santhavajāto hoti? idha, gahapati, ekacco gihīhi saṃsaṭṭho viharati sahanandī sahasokī, sukhitesu sukhito, dukkhitesu dukkhito, uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu attanā tesu yogaṃ āpajjati.

58346.grammar: fem, abstr, in comps, from saṇṭhahati

examples.text: so puratthimena nagarassa navaṃ santhā-agāraṃ kārāpetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā khar'ājinaṃ nivāsetvā sappitelena kāyaṃ abbhañjitvā magavisāṇena piṭṭhiṃ kaṇḍuvamāno navaṃ santh'āgāraṃ pavisati, saddhiṃ mahesiyā brāhmaṇena ca purohitena.

58347.meaning1: meeting hall; council hall; (comm) sacrificial temple
58347.commentary: (MNa) santh'āgāran'ti adhunā kāritaṃ santh'āgāraṃ, ekā mahāsālā'ti attho. (MNa) santh'āgāre'ti rājakulānaṃ atth'ānusāsana-santh'āgāra-sālāyaṃ.

examples.text: so puratthimena nagarassa navaṃ santh'āgāraṃ kārāpetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā khar'ājinaṃ nivāsetvā sappitelena kāyaṃ abbhañjitvā magavisāṇena piṭṭhiṃ kaṇḍuvamāno navaṃ santh'āgāraṃ pavisati, saddhiṃ mahesiyā brāhmaṇena ca purohitena.
tena kho pana samayena pañcamattāni licchavisatāni santh'āgāre sannipatitāni honti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.

58349.commentary: (ANa) catūhi paccayehi attano ca parassa ca antarapaṭicchādanavasena santharaṇaṃ āmisasanthāro, dhammena santharaṇaṃ dhammasanthāro.

examples.text: āmisasanthāro ca dhammasanthāro ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve santhārā. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ santhārānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammasanthāro'ti.
na hi nūn'imassa samaṇassa, santhāro sattamāsiko, uppāṭakehi sañchanno, ten'āyaṃ samaṇo sukhī.
santharāpetvā'ti aññaṃ santharāpetvā. anupasampannaṃ santharāpeti, tassa palibodho. upasampannaṃ santharāpeti, santhārakassa palibodho.
yo pana bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena cīvaraṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, yathāsanthutaṃ bhikkhū saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇāmentī'ti, pācittiyaṃ.
asanthutaṃ maṃ cirasanthutena, nimīni sāmā adhuvaṃ dhuvena, mayā'pi sāmā nimineyya aññaṃ, ito ahaṃ dūrataraṃ gamissan'ti.
kamm'antaṭṭhāne eko jamburukkho bahalapattapalāso sandacchāyo ahosi.

evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghosit'ārāme. tena kho pana samayena sandako paribbājako pilakkhaguhāyaṃ paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ pañcamattehi paribbājakasatehi.

58359.meaning1: giving good shade; providing dense shade cover

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sāriputta, rukkho same bhūmibhāge jāto bahalapattapalāso sandacchāyo.
kīdiso, bho purisa, kiṃsuko'ti? so evaṃ vadeyya, bahalapattapalāso sandacchāyo kho, ambho purisa, kiṃsuko, seyyathā'pi nigrodho'ti.
ramaṇīyo vata, bho, bhūmibhāgo, pāsādiko ca vanasaṇḍo, nadī ca sandati setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā, samantā ca gocaragāmo. alaṃ vat'idaṃ kulaputtassa padhān'atthikassa padhānāyā'ti.
dhitipparaṃ kiṃ mama citta kāhisi, na te alaṃ citta vas'ānuvattako, na jātu bhastaṃ ubhatomukhaṃ chupe, dhi'r'atthu pūraṃ nava sotasandaniṃ.
sahassayuttaṃ hayavāhanaṃ subhaṃ, āruyh'imaṃ sandanaṃ n'ekacittaṃ, uyyānabhūmiṃ abhito anukkamaṃ, purin'dado bhūtapatī'va vāsavo.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītidhenusahassāni ahesuṃ dukūlasandanāni kaṃs'ūpadhāraṇāni.

58364.commentary: (MNa) nadiñ'ca sandantin'ti sandamānañ'ca maṇikkhandhasadisaṃ vimalanīlasītalasalilaṃ nerañjaraṃ nadiṃ addasaṃ.

examples.text: tatth'addasaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ, pāsādikañ'ca vanasaṇḍaṃ, nadiñ'ca sandantiṃ setakaṃ supatitthaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ, samantā ca gocaragāmaṃ.
idāni sā bhante nadikā cakkacchinnā parittā luḷitā āvilā sandamānā mayi upasaṅkamante acchā vippasannā anāvilā sandittha.
etāsaṃ sandamānānaṃ, sāgaro sampaṭicchati, jahanti purimaṃ nāmaṃ, sāgaro't'eva ñāyati.
yānaṃ nāma vayhaṃ ratho sakaṭaṃ sandamānikā sivikā pāṭaṅkī.
no ca sandassako hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no parahitāya.
ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… ovādako viññāpako sandassako samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnan'ti?
te tena bhotā gotamena dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamanti avalokayamānā'y'eva avijahitattā.

atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo mantāṇiputto bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena andhavanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami divāvihārāya.

58370.grammar: prp of caus pass of saṃ √dis, caus, pass, trans (+acc)
58370.meaning1: being compared; being checked; being verified

examples.text: tāni ce sutte otāriyamānāni vinaye sandassiyamānāni na c'eva sutte otaranti na vinaye sandissanti, niṭṭham'ettha gantabbaṃ, addhā, idaṃ na c'eva tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa, imassa ca bhikkhuno duggahitan'ti.

58371.grammar: prp of caus pass of saṃ √dis, caus, pass, intrans (+instr)

examples.text: tesaṃ vipassinā bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dhammiyā kathāya sandassiyamānānaṃ samādapiyamānānaṃ samuttejiyamānānaṃ sampahaṃsiyamānānaṃ nacirass'eva anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu.

58372.meaning1: should be compared (to); should be checked (with); should be verified (with)
58372.meaningLit: to cause to be seen together

examples.text: tassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno bhāsitaṃ n'eva abhinanditabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ. anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā tāni padabyañjanāni sādhukaṃ uggahetvā sutte otāretabbāni, vinaye sandassetabbāni.

58373.synonym: akkhāti, ārocayati, āroceti, āvikaroti, uttānīkaroti, upadisati, jānāpeti, jotayati, joteti, dīpeti, pakāseti, pilapati

examples.text: so bhuttāvī anumodati, na taṃ bhattaṃ garahati, na aññaṃ bhattaṃ paṭikaṅkhati, añña'd'atthu dhammiyā kathāya taṃ parisaṃ sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhū nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti

58374.meaning1: explains, encourages, inspires and enthuses; instructs, exhorts, incites and gladdens

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhū nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti
tena kho pana samayena āyasmā visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti

58375.meaning1: to explain to; to instruct (someone with)
58375.commentary: (PMa) sandassetun'ti paraṃ ñāpetu'kāmassa paraṃ sandassetuṃ. parassa pana vacanaṃ suṇantassā'pi labbhati'y'eva.

examples.text: nappaṭibalo hoti gilānaṃ kālena kālaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato gilān'upaṭṭhāko n'ālaṃ gilānaṃ upaṭṭhātuṃ.
pañca dhamme sandassetuṃ byañjana-nirutt'ābhilāpā, pañca atthe sandassetuṃ byañjana-nirutt'ābhilāpā. aññā dhammaniruttiyo, aññā atthaniruttiyo.
so taṃ parisaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamati. so n'ātisīghaṃ gacchati, n'ātisaṇikaṃ gacchati, na ca muccitu'kāmo gacchati.

atha kho kassapagottassa bhikkhuno bhagavati sikkhāpadapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya bhikkhū sandassente samādapente samuttejente sampahaṃsente ahu'd'eva akkhanti ahu appaccayo, adhisallikhat'ev'āyaṃ samaṇo'ti.

58378.commentary: (DNa) sandassesī'ti, idaṃ dānaṃ dātā evarūpaṃ sampattiṃ labhatī'ti dassetvā dassetvā kathesi.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.

58379.commentary: (MNt) saccena saccan'ti purimena vacīsaccena pacchimaṃ vacīsaccaṃ sandahati asaccena anantarikattā.

examples.text: saccaṃ vadatī'ti saccavādī. saccena saccaṃ sandahati ghaṭetī'ti saccasandho. na antar'antarā musā vadatī'ti attho.

58383.meaning2: having connected, having united, having fit

examples.text: yassa papañcā ṭhiti ca n'atthi, sandānaṃ palighañ'ca vītivatto, taṃ nittaṇhaṃ muniṃ carantaṃ, n'āvajānāti sadevako'pi loko'ti.
chetvā naddhiṃ varattañ'ca, sandānaṃ sah'anukkamaṃ, ukkhittapalighaṃ buddhaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

58385.meaning1: rope and tether; cord and halter

examples.text: nāgo'va sandānaguṇāni chetvā, deve tāvatiṃse atikkamiṃsu, saindā devā sapajāpatikā, sabbe sudhammāya sabhāy'upaviṭṭhā.
idāni sā bhante nadikā cakkacchinnā parittā luḷitā āvilā sandamānā mayi upasaṅkamante acchā vippasannā anāvilā sandittha.
parammukhāvikappanā nāma imaṃ cīvaraṃ vikappan'atthāya tuyhaṃ dammī'ti. tena vattabbo, ko te mitto vā sandiṭṭho vā'ti? itthan'nāmo ca itthan'nāmo cā'ti.

58394.meaning1: friendship; companionship; fact of being friends

examples.text: yathāsanthutaṃ nāma yathāmittatā yathāsandiṭṭhatā yathāsambhattatā yathāsamān'upajjhāyakatā yathāsamān'ācariyakatā.

58395.meaning1: clearly pronounced, slow, etc. and without error

58396.meaning1: one's own belief; one's own opinion

examples.text: sandiṭṭhiyā c'eva vīvadātā, saṃsuddhapaññā kusalā mutīmā, na tesaṃ koci parihīnapañño, diṭṭhī hi tesam'pi tathā samattā.

att'ukkaṃsakaparavambhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, sandiṭṭhiparāmāsā ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggino, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, kuhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāp'icchā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāpamittā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā

58397.meaning1: directly visible; evident; real; perceivable; (comm) able to be seen by oneself

examples.text: dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti
bhuñja, bhikkhu, mānusake kāme, mā sandiṭṭhikaṃ hitvā kālikaṃ anudhāvī'ti.
